description: Dev-only staged remediation framework candidate for executing one bounded repo-improvement stage at a time with explicit artifact contracts

required.name: run_order_doc
required.description: Stage source of truth describing the staged remediation sequence

required.name: stage_id
required.description: Identifier of the single stage to execute in this run

required.name: repo_scope
required.description: Repo paths in scope for the current stage

required.name: validation_profile
required.description: Commands and checks required to validate the stage

optional.name: resume_from_artifacts
optional.description: Previously emitted stage artifacts used to resume a blocked or reopened run

optional.name: stage_definition
optional.description: Structured stage definition JSON conforming to the framework schema
